name: an arrow in flight from sixty blocks
source: recording sha256 c005ca31a2f5a47634f23f90d87d2b28a7ab6839b11e4266a0aaee8f83589564, vanilla 1.8.9 server sha256 c18e4245073aaff580eb7359902f0251436568b1647a9e443a924cdb73fa8312, 2026-08-18, entities summoned from the server console through the capture proxy
because: Protocol 47 sends an entity's position as int32 fixed point in units of 1/32 of a block, so a captured checkpoint is the true position truncated to that grid and nothing finer is observable. The measured deviation on these trajectories is about half of it.
